text:
marco: heads-up — customer reported console p95 for v2 jumped but billing shows tokens under v1. traced the window and found many requests labeled served_by=\"legacy-v1\" even though client requested v2.
anya: was this the cross-region emergency fallback we enabled?
marco: yes, triggered when local v2 pool exhausted. problem: console and billing attribute differently (console reads request header, billing reads serve log). customers see conflicting data.
frank: quick fixes: 1) make the routing layer emit final_model and fallback_cause as structured fields on the request event; 2) attach a coarse \"serve_topology\": same-rgn | cross-rgn | cross-cloud to avoid high-cardinality.
telemetry-bot: note: adding fields increases cardinality — recommend tenant sampling for full tuples and surface aggregates for all traffic.
anya: UX asks: add a \"Model Attribution\" panel that shows percent of requests where requested != actual with an example list + trace links and a CSV export. Also show a time-series of attribution_delta and billed_delta.
frank: billing change: temporarily write both billed_by_requested and billed_by_actual for 14 days so we can reconcile and pick canonical attribution. then run a compare job:
product-bot: suggested alerting thresholds: internal alert if global mismatch >0.4% in 5m, tenant email if mismatch >1.5% over 24h and >50k tokens.
marco: SDK consent idea: header x-rw-cross-region-consent: opt_in/opt_out/ask. default ask for new SDKs. Console should display tenant state and let admins toggle.
anya: timeline: week 1 telemetry + coarse topology tag; week 2 dual-write + reconciliation job + internal alert; week 3 console panel + banner; week 5 SDK header + tenant toggle.
frank: sql snippet for quick ops query: ```sql
SELECT tenant_id, requested_model, actual_model, count(*) requests
FROM request_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant_id, requested_model, actual_model
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
marco: volunteers? frank will do routing change; anya will mock UI; telemetry-bot (sam) will do schema PR and sampling; billing (olga) will own dual-write.
anya: I'll put a short RFC with customer-facing language for the banner.
marco: thanks all — want to avoid silent surprises. we'll review in eng-platform sync. :thumbsup:
